title: How is Charlemagne connected to Rin Itoshi?
description:
A Raphael fresco, 170 popes, a Vatican audience and Expo 2025 link the first Holy Roman Emperor to Blue Lock's Rin Itoshi.

Charlemagne → Pope Leo III → Pope Francis → Fumio Kishida → Masakazu Tokura → Yusei Yagi → Rin Itoshi

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
